title: SDLC Task Identifier v1
description: A task identity composed of a WorkItemId, a literal pipe separator, and a StepId. The separator makes the boundary between the work-item identity and the task-local step identity explicit.
$comment: TaskIdentifier has the form {WorkItemId}|{StepId}. For example, WI-0003|05 identifies legacy step 05 in WI-0003, while WI-0003|50000000 identifies the eight-digit task-tree position 50000000 in WI-0003. The host must verify that the identifier agrees with the owning task record.
